title: Modal perfect
note: must/might/should/could/can't/needn't have + past participle · first draft night/2026-08-06

items.en: She must have left already.
accepts: She must have left already.
items.explanation: must have + past participle: strong deduction about the past.
items.explanation_cz: must have + past participle: silná dedukce o minulosti.

items.en: He might have forgotten the meeting.
accepts: He might have forgotten the meeting.
items.explanation: might have: possibility about the past.
items.explanation_cz: might have: možnost v minulosti.

items.en: You should have called me.
accepts: You should have called me.
items.explanation: should have: past criticism or regret about what was better.
items.explanation_cz: should have: minulá výtka nebo lítost.

items.en: They could have won if they had tried.
items.gap: They could ____ won if they had tried.
accepts: They could have won if they had tried.
items.explanation: could have: past possibility or ability not taken.
items.explanation_cz: could have: nevyužitá minulá možnost.

items.en: I can't have left my keys there.
items.cz: Nemůžu tam nechat klíče. / To není možné, že jsem tam nechal klíče.
items.gap: I can't ____ left my keys there.
accepts: I can't have left my keys there.
I cannot have left my keys there.
items.explanation: can't have: strong deduction that something was impossible.
items.explanation_cz: can't have: silná dedukce, že něco nebylo možné.

items.en: She may have missed the train.
accepts: She may have missed the train.
items.explanation: may have: softer possibility about the past.
items.explanation_cz: may have: mírnější možnost v minulosti.

items.en: We needn't have hurried.
items.cz: Nemuseli jsme spěchat. (ukázalo se, že to bylo zbytečné)
accepts: We needn't have hurried.
We need not have hurried.
items.explanation: needn't have: you did it, but it was unnecessary.
items.explanation_cz: needn't have: udělali jste to, ale bylo to zbytečné.

items.en: He must have been tired.
accepts: He must have been tired.
items.explanation: must have been + adjective: strong past deduction about state.
items.explanation_cz: must have been + přídavné jméno: silná minulá dedukce.

items.en: You could have told me earlier.
items.cz: Mohl jsi mi to říct dřív.
accepts: You could have told me earlier.
items.explanation: could have for reproach: you had the chance but did not.
items.explanation_cz: could have pro výčitku: měl jsi šanci, ale neudělal jsi to.

items.en: They shouldn't have spent so much.
accepts: They shouldn't have spent so much.
They should not have spent so much.
items.explanation: shouldn't have: past advice broken / criticism.
items.explanation_cz: shouldn't have: porušená rada / výtka.

items.en: Someone must have taken my bag.
accepts: Someone must have taken my bag.
items.explanation: must have: only logical past explanation.
items.explanation_cz: must have: jediné logické minulé vysvětlení.

items.en: She might have been delayed.
accepts: She might have been delayed.
items.explanation: might have been + past participle: passive possibility.
items.explanation_cz: might have been + past participle: pasivní možnost.

items.en: I should have studied more for the exam.
items.cz: Měl jsem se na zkoušku víc učit.
items.gap: I should ____ studied more for the exam.
accepts: I should have studied more for the exam.
items.explanation: should have: personal regret about past effort.
items.explanation_cz: should have: osobní lítost nad minulou snahou.

items.en: He can't have finished already — he only started.
items.cz: Nemůže mít už hotovo — teprve začal.
items.gap: He can't ____ finished already — he only started.
accepts: He can't have finished already — he only started.
He cannot have finished already — he only started.
items.explanation: can't have: refuse a past conclusion as impossible.
items.explanation_cz: can't have: odmítnutí minulého závěru jako nemožného.

items.en: You needn't have bought flowers — we already had some.
items.cz: Nemusel jsi kupovat květiny — už jsme nějaké měli.
items.gap: You needn't ____ bought flowers — we already had some.
accepts: You needn't have bought flowers — we already had some.
You need not have bought flowers — we already had some.
items.explanation: needn't have: action happened but was unnecessary.
items.explanation_cz: needn't have: akce se stala, ale byla zbytečná.

items.en: They may have gone home already.
accepts: They may have gone home already.
items.explanation: may have: past possibility, not strong.
items.explanation_cz: may have: minulá možnost, ne silná.

items.en: We could have taken a taxi.
accepts: We could have taken a taxi.
items.explanation: could have: available past option not used.
items.explanation_cz: could have: dostupná minulá volba nevyužitá.

items.en: She must have been waiting for hours.
items.gap: She must ____ been waiting for hours.
accepts: She must have been waiting for hours.
items.explanation: must have been + -ing: strong deduction about past ongoing action.
items.explanation_cz: must have been + -ing: silná dedukce o probíhající minulosti.

items.en: You shouldn't have shouted at him.
accepts: You shouldn't have shouted at him.
You should not have shouted at him.
items.explanation: shouldn't have: criticism of past behaviour.
items.explanation_cz: shouldn't have: kritika minulého chování.

items.en: It might have been a mistake.
accepts: It might have been a mistake.
items.explanation: might have been + noun: soft past possibility.
items.explanation_cz: might have been + podstatné jméno: mírná minulá možnost.

items.en: He may not have seen your message.
items.gap: He may not ____ seen your message.
accepts: He may not have seen your message.
items.explanation: may not have: possible that something did not happen.
items.explanation_cz: may not have: možná se něco nestalo.

items.en: I must have left my phone at home.
items.gap: I must ____ left my phone at home.
accepts: I must have left my phone at home.
items.explanation: must have: best explanation of a present problem.
items.explanation_cz: must have: nejlepší vysvětlení přítomného problému.

items.en: She could have been a doctor.
accepts: She could have been a doctor.
items.explanation: could have been: past potential career / path not taken.
items.explanation_cz: could have been: minulý potenciál nevyužitý.

items.en: You should have worn a coat.
accepts: You should have worn a coat.
items.explanation: should have: better past choice (advice after the fact).
items.explanation_cz: should have: lepší minulá volba (rada dodatečně).

items.en: They can't have known about the plan.
items.gap: They can't ____ known about the plan.
accepts: They can't have known about the plan.
They cannot have known about the plan.
items.explanation: can't have known: impossible that they knew.
items.explanation_cz: can't have known: nemožné, že to věděli.

items.en: We might have made a wrong turn.
items.gap: We might ____ made a wrong turn.
accepts: We might have made a wrong turn.
items.explanation: might have: tentative past explanation.
items.explanation_cz: might have: opatrné minulé vysvětlení.

items.en: He needn't have apologised — nobody was angry.
items.cz: Nemusel se omlouvat — nikdo se nezlobil.
items.gap: He needn't ____ apologised — nobody was angry.
accepts: He needn't have apologised — nobody was angry.
He need not have apologised — nobody was angry.
items.explanation: needn't have: apology happened but was unnecessary.
items.explanation_cz: needn't have: omluva se stala, ale byla zbytečná.

items.en: She must have forgotten our appointment.
accepts: She must have forgotten our appointment.
items.explanation: must have + past participle (forgotten, not forgot).
items.explanation_cz: must have + past participle (forgotten, ne forgot).

items.en: I could have helped if you had asked.
items.gap: I could ____ helped if you had asked.
accepts: I could have helped if you had asked.
items.explanation: could have + condition: past help available but not requested.
items.explanation_cz: could have + podmínka: pomoc byla k dispozici.

items.en: You may have heard this story before.
items.cz: Možná jsi ten příběh už slyšel.
items.gap: You may ____ heard this story before.
accepts: You may have heard this story before.
items.explanation: may have: polite possibility about past experience.
items.explanation_cz: may have: zdvořilá možnost o minulé zkušenosti.

cards.title: What it is
cards.body: Modal perfect talks about the **past** with a modal: deduction, possibility, criticism, or wasted chance.

cards.title: Form (short)
points: must / might / may / could / should / can't / needn't + have + past participle
Negative: shouldn't have, can't have, may not have, needn't have

cards.title: When to use which
points: Best past explanation from evidence → must have
Possible but not taken → could have
You did it but it was useless → needn't have

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: must + past simple (must left) instead of must have left
Mixing didn't need to (no action) with needn't have (action done)
Using can have for past deduction (prefer can't have / could have)
Saying V3 — call it past participle

cards.title: Quick check
cards.body: Pick the attitude first, then lock the form modal + have + past participle.
points: How sure? → must / might / may / can't
Advice after the fact? → should have
Did it for nothing? → needn't have
